string-array.name: empty_insults_mild
string-array.item: Your list is blank. Let\'s fix it.

string-array.name: empty_insults_normal
string-array.item: Screen as empty as your mind?
Empty list, empty life. Wake up.

string-array.name: empty_insults_extreme
string-array.item: Add some tasks, you lazy garbage!
Your list is a void, just like your future. Add a task NOW!
Fucking empty! Do you even have a life?
Stop staring at a blank screen and do something useful!
You are an absolute disgrace. Write down a goal!

string-array.name: slacker_insults_normal
string-array.item: Your todo list is laughing at you.
Is doing nothing your full-time job?

string-array.name: slacker_insults_extreme
string-array.item: Disgrace to your kind! Get up!
Your future is as empty as this screen!
Are you allergic to productivity or just naturally useless?

string-array.name: wannabe_insults_mild
string-array.item: Not bad, push a bit more.

string-array.name: wannabe_insults_normal
string-array.item: WANNABE is not a GIGACHAD. Grind more.
Don\'t stop now, you\'re still average.
You\'re trying, but I need more blood and sweat.
Average effort yields average results. Push harder.
Stop pretending and actually finish the list.

string-array.name: wannabe_insults_extreme
string-array.item: Think you\'re cool with 50%? NOPE. FINISH IT!
Don\'t be a spineless coward, get it done!
Half-assing it won\'t get you to the top. Keep pushing!
You\'re stuck in the mud of mediocrity. Grind!
Finish what you started or go cry in the corner!

string-array.name: gigachad_insults_normal
string-array.item: Respect earned, don\'t lose it tomorrow.
You crushed that list. Keep it up.
Now that\'s how you dominate the day.

string-array.name: gigachad_insults_extreme
string-array.item: You conquered the day, you magnificent beast!
GIGACHAD of the year. Flawless victory!
I\'m actually impressed. You didn\'t suck today!
Absolute unit of productivity. You own this day!
Unstoppable force! Keep this grind going!

string-array.name: notif_inactive_body_mild
string-array.item: It\'s been 3 days. A small step is better than none!
Your task list is waiting for you. Let\'s go.

string-array.name: notif_inactive_body_normal
string-array.item: 3 days of doing absolutely nothing. Your future self is crying.
Your list is gathering dust. Pick up the pace.

string-array.name: notif_inactive_body_extreme
string-array.item: You haven\'t done shit for 3 days! Your list is as empty as your future!
Are you dead? Get up and do something useful with your miserable life!

string-array.name: notif_expired_body_mild
string-array.item: Mission \'%1$s\' missed the %2$s deadline. Better luck next time.

string-array.name: notif_expired_body_normal
string-array.item: Mission \'%1$s\' failed! It was due at %2$s.

string-array.name: notif_expired_body_extreme
string-array.item: You blew it! \'%1$s\' is overdue since %2$s. Absolute failure!

string-array.name: notif_urgent_body_normal
string-array.item: You haven\'t finished \'%1$s\'! Clock is ticking: %2$d mins left.

string-array.name: notif_urgent_body_extreme
string-array.item: Only %2$d mins left for \'%1$s\'! Don\'t you dare fail this!

string-array.name: notif_end_of_day_body_mild
string-array.item: Try to cross off a few more items before the day ends.

string-array.name: notif_end_of_day_body_normal
string-array.item: The day is ending and you haven\'t finished the plan! Move it!

string-array.name: notif_end_of_day_body_extreme
string-array.item: The day is almost over and your list is pathetic! Grind NOW or stay a loser!
